day_shape: CENTCOM says it struck three Iranian oil tankers including one off Kharg Island, UK Maritime Trade Operations reports a multi-vessel incident off Oman, IDF reports strikes on Hezbollah sites in southern Lebanon killing three, and Khamenei's office pushes a '40 demands' cycle.

threads.label: CENTCOM tanker strikes widen to Kharg
threads.summary: CENTCOM said its forces struck three Iranian crude oil tankers on 5 September, including one off Kharg Island roughly 300 miles northwest of Hormuz, days after strikes on two NITC tankers off Jask. Adm. Brad Cooper warned the IRGC that further attacks on US ships would bring proportionally larger strikes on Iran's 'limited and exposed oil fleet'.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz vessel incident
threads.summary: UK Maritime Trade Operations reported an incident involving several vessels north of Omani shores, with some outlets reporting attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz. Iran International carried commentary from former CENTCOM commander Joseph Votel and a Tehran debate on whether Iran is exhausting its Hormuz leverage.

threads.label: IDF strikes in southern Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF said overnight airstrikes in southern Lebanon targeted Hezbollah operatives and weapons depots in response to an attempted drone attack against Israeli troops in the Security Zone. Lebanese health authorities reported three killed near Nabatieh and Rmadiyeh; Defa Press claimed the Lebanese Health Ministry's cumulative toll had passed 4,358.

threads.label: Khamenei '40 demands' messaging cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office and IRIB pushed an infographic of 40 demands from the Supreme Leader to system officials structured around ideological, economic, management, security and foreign-policy pillars. Parallel items carried Basij chief Tayyeb saying America 'must abide by the agreement's terms' and Speaker Qalibaf on 'jihadi management'.

threads.label: Iran economy, sanctions and pressure
threads.summary: Iran's Central Bank deputy governor said the bank had prepared alternative routes for new sanctions and announced coin forward papers from 18 Shahrivar, while Iran International reported industrial collapse in appliances and warnings on gold-leasing schemes. Former Israeli NSC chief Jacob Nagel told the Jerusalem Post six to nine months of sustained economic pressure could push Iranians back into the streets.

events.title_en: Death toll in Lebanon exceeds 4,350
events.summary_en: Death toll in Lebanon exceeds 4,350. Whilst the pro-Western Lebanese government claims to have reached an agreement with the Zionist regime, that regime continues to massacre civilians in the country. The Lebanese Ministry of Health reported that from 11 Esfand until today, Saturday 14 Shahrivar, 4,358 people have been killed. The Lebanese institution also stated that during the Zionist regime's attacks in this time period, 12,359 people were wounded. The Lebanese Ministry of Health also reported this morning that according to the latest casualty figures from Israeli air strikes on Friday, four people were killed and 30 others wounded.

events.summary_en: US makes its 35 per cent share in Venezuelan oil company permanent. According to a Reuters report, the US government has used a financial instrument called a "one-cent warrant" to maintain its 35 per cent stake in North American Blue Energy Partners. In this way, if the company raises more capital to develop Venezuelan oil fields and new shares are issued, the US share will not be diluted. The US already enjoys the benefits of a 35 per cent shareholder, including receipt of dividends, even before the warrants are converted to shares.
